# Patient-level integrity checks ------------------------------------------------
assert_unique_patient_values <- function(df, context = "patient-level table") {
  required <- c("Method", "Cell_Type", "Patient_ID", "Timepoint", "cluster", "Value")
  missing <- base::setdiff(required, names(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(context, " is missing required columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  }

  dup <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Patient_ID), !is.na(Timepoint), !is.na(cluster)) %>%
    dplyr::count(Method, Cell_Type, Patient_ID, Timepoint, cluster, name = "n_rows") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_rows > 1)

  if (nrow(dup) > 0) {
    stop(
      context, " contains duplicate patient-level values. ",
      "Technical replicates must be resolved before statistics/plots. Examples: ",
      paste(utils::head(paste0(dup$Method, "/", dup$Cell_Type, "/", dup$Patient_ID, "/", dup$Timepoint), 10), collapse = " | "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

assert_unique_patient_values(immune_patient, "ORIGINAL immune patient table")
assert_unique_patient_values(immune_patient_aggregated, "AGGREGATED immune patient table")

# Unpaired statistics

For each method, cell type, and timepoint, the pipeline compares immune estimates across CIMIC clusters.

- If `k = 2`, the global test is Wilcoxon rank-sum.
- If `k >= 3`, the global test is Kruskal-Wallis, followed by Dunn post hoc testing with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction.

```{r unpaired-stats}
summarise_by_cluster <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster))
}

empty_skip_tbl <- function() {
  tibble(analysis = character(), Method = character(), Cell_Type = character(), Timepoint = character(), reason = character(), k = integer(), n_total = integer(), n_unique_value = integer(), min_cluster_n = integer())
}

make_skip_row <- function(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint, analysis, reason, k = NA_integer_, n_total = NA_integer_, n_unique_value = NA_integer_, min_cluster_n = NA_integer_) {
  tibble(analysis = analysis, Method = as.character(Method), Cell_Type = as.character(Cell_Type), Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint), reason = reason, k = as.integer(k), n_total = as.integer(n_total), n_unique_value = as.integer(n_unique_value), min_cluster_n = as.integer(min_cluster_n))
}

unpaired_global_one <- function(df, Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint) {
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(Value), !is.na(cluster), !is.na(Patient_ID))

  # Statistics are strictly patient-level: one value per patient for the
  # current Method x Cell_Type x Timepoint.
  dup <- df %>%
    dplyr::count(Patient_ID, name = "n_rows") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_rows > 1)
  if (nrow(dup) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate patients reached unpaired statistics for ",
      Method, " / ", Cell_Type, " / ", as.character(Timepoint),
      ": ", paste(dup$Patient_ID, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  kk <- dplyr::n_distinct(df$cluster)
  n_total <- nrow(df)
  n_unique <- dplyr::n_distinct(df$Value)
  group_sizes <- table(df$cluster)
  min_n <- if (kk > 0) min(as.integer(group_sizes)) else NA_integer_

  if (kk < 2) {
    return(list(out = NULL, skip = make_skip_row(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint, "unpaired_global", "k<2", kk, n_total, n_unique, min_n)))
  }

  summ <- summarise_by_cluster(df)

  if (!is.na(min_n) && min_n < MIN_UNPAIRED_GROUP_N) {
    return(list(
      out = tibble(
        Method = as.character(Method), Cell_Type = as.character(Cell_Type),
        Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint), test = ifelse(kk == 2, "wilcox_rank_sum", "kruskal"),
        p_value = NA_real_, n_clusters = kk, note = paste0("skipped_min_group_n<", MIN_UNPAIRED_GROUP_N),
        summary = list(summ)
      ),
      skip = make_skip_row(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint, "unpaired_global", "group_too_small", kk, n_total, n_unique, min_n)
    ))
  }

  if (n_unique < 2) {
    return(list(
      out = tibble(
        Method = as.character(Method), Cell_Type = as.character(Cell_Type),
        Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint), test = ifelse(kk == 2, "wilcox_rank_sum", "kruskal"),
        p_value = NA_real_, n_clusters = kk, note = "skipped_no_variation", summary = list(summ)
      ),
      skip = make_skip_row(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint, "unpaired_global", "no_variation", kk, n_total, n_unique, min_n)
    ))
  }

  p <- if (kk == 2) {
    # Two independent CIM groups -> two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
    # exact = FALSE is intentional because deconvolution outputs commonly
    # contain ties/zeros; R's exact calculation is not valid with ties.
    # IMPORTANT: do not pass paired=FALSE to the formula interface.
    # stats::wilcox.test.formula() does not accept a paired argument and can
    # therefore return an error/NA when wrapped in tryCatch. With two CIM
    # groups, the formula interface is intrinsically an independent-samples
    # Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
    tryCatch(
      stats::wilcox.test(
        Value ~ cluster,
        data = df,
        alternative = "two.sided",
        exact = FALSE,
        correct = TRUE
      )$p.value,
      error = function(e) {
        warning(
          "Unpaired Wilcoxon failed for ", Method, " / ", Cell_Type, " / ",
          as.character(Timepoint), ": ", conditionMessage(e)
        )
        NA_real_
      }
    )
  } else {
    tryCatch(
      stats::kruskal.test(Value ~ cluster, data = df)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
  }

  list(
    out = tibble(
      Method = as.character(Method),
      Cell_Type = as.character(Cell_Type),
      Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint),
      test = ifelse(kk == 2, "wilcox_rank_sum", "kruskal"),
      p_value = p,
      n_clusters = kk,
      note = NA_character_,
      summary = list(summ)
    ),
    skip = NULL
  )
}

unpaired_dunn_one <- function(df, Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint, drop_small_groups_n = 2) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    filter(is.finite(Value), !is.na(cluster)) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    filter(n() >= drop_small_groups_n) %>%
    ungroup()

  kk <- n_distinct(df2$cluster)
  n_total <- nrow(df2)
  n_unique <- n_distinct(df2$Value)
  min_n <- if (kk > 0) min(as.integer(table(df2$cluster))) else NA_integer_

  if (kk < 3) return(list(out = NULL, skip = make_skip_row(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint, "unpaired_dunn", "k<3_after_filter", kk, n_total, n_unique, min_n)))
  if (n_unique < 2) return(list(out = NULL, skip = make_skip_row(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint, "unpaired_dunn", "no_variation", kk, n_total, n_unique, min_n)))

  cl_summ <- summarise_by_cluster(df2) %>% rename(n_group = n, mean_group = mean, sd_group = sd)
  dt <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(FSA::dunnTest(Value ~ cluster, data = df2, method = "bh")$res), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(dt)) return(list(out = NULL, skip = make_skip_row(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint, "unpaired_dunn", "dunn_error", kk, n_total, n_unique, min_n)))

  desired_pairwise_order <- c("C1 - C2", "C3 - C2", "C1 - C3")

  out <- as_tibble(dt) %>%
    rename(comparison = Comparison, z = Z, p_unadj = P.unadj, fdr = P.adj) %>%
    mutate(
      Method = as.character(Method),
      Cell_Type = as.character(Cell_Type),
      Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint),
      comparison_original = as.character(comparison),
      z = as.numeric(z),
      z = case_when(
        comparison_original %in% c("C2 - C1", "C2 - C3", "C3 - C1") ~ -z,
        TRUE ~ z
      ),
      comparison = case_when(
        comparison_original %in% c("C1 - C2", "C2 - C1") ~ "C1 - C2",
        comparison_original %in% c("C3 - C2", "C2 - C3") ~ "C3 - C2",
        comparison_original %in% c("C1 - C3", "C3 - C1") ~ "C1 - C3",
        TRUE ~ comparison_original
      ),
      cluster1 = sub(" -.*$", "", comparison),
      cluster2 = sub("^.*- ", "", comparison)
    ) %>%
    left_join(cl_summ %>% rename(cluster1 = cluster, n1 = n_group, mean1 = mean_group, sd1 = sd_group), by = "cluster1") %>%
    left_join(cl_summ %>% rename(cluster2 = cluster, n2 = n_group, mean2 = mean_group, sd2 = sd_group), by = "cluster2") %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = factor(comparison, levels = desired_pairwise_order, ordered = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(comparison) %>%
    mutate(comparison = as.character(comparison)) %>%
    select(-comparison_original) %>%
    relocate(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint, comparison, cluster1, cluster2, n1, mean1, sd1, n2, mean2, sd2, z, p_unadj, fdr)

  list(out = out, skip = NULL)
}

compute_unpaired_all <- function(immune_patient_df, out_prefix, drop_small_groups_n = 2, write_outputs = FALSE) {
  # Safety step: all unpaired statistics use mapped CIM groups.
  # Numeric cluster IDs are mapped first; pooled analyses compare C1, C2, and C3 regardless of NKI/SMC source cohort.
  immune_patient_df <- apply_cluster_mapping(immune_patient_df) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = droplevels(cluster))

  keys <- immune_patient_df %>% dplyr::distinct(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint) %>% dplyr::arrange(Timepoint, Method, Cell_Type)

  global_rows <- list()
  dunn_rows <- list()
  skip_rows <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(keys))) {
    key <- keys[i, ]
    method_i <- key$Method[[1]]
    cell_type_i <- key$Cell_Type[[1]]
    timepoint_i <- key$Timepoint[[1]]

    df_sub <- immune_patient_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$Method == .env$method_i,
        .data$Cell_Type == .env$cell_type_i,
        .data$Timepoint == .env$timepoint_i,
        is.finite(.data$Value),
        !is.na(.data$Patient_ID),
        !is.na(.data$cluster)
      )

    g <- unpaired_global_one(df_sub, method_i, cell_type_i, timepoint_i)
    if (!is.null(g$out)) global_rows[[length(global_rows) + 1]] <- g$out
    if (!is.null(g$skip)) skip_rows[[length(skip_rows) + 1]] <- g$skip

    d <- unpaired_dunn_one(df_sub, method_i, cell_type_i, timepoint_i, drop_small_groups_n)
    if (!is.null(d$out)) dunn_rows[[length(dunn_rows) + 1]] <- d$out
    if (!is.null(d$skip)) skip_rows[[length(skip_rows) + 1]] <- d$skip
  }

  global_tbl <- if (length(global_rows)) bind_rows(global_rows) else tibble()
  dunn_tbl <- if (length(dunn_rows)) bind_rows(dunn_rows) else tibble()
  skipped <- if (length(skip_rows)) bind_rows(skip_rows) else empty_skip_tbl()

  global_tbl <- global_tbl %>% mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

  global_wide <- global_tbl %>%
    tidyr::unnest(summary) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint, test, p_value, FDR, n_clusters, note),
      names_from = cluster,
      values_from = c(n, mean, sd),
      names_glue = "{cluster}_{.value}"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Timepoint, Method, Cell_Type)

  if (isTRUE(write_outputs)) {
    write.csv(global_wide, file.path(DIRS$tables, paste0(out_prefix, "_unpaired_global.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(dunn_tbl, file.path(DIRS$tables, paste0(out_prefix, "_unpaired_dunn.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  }

  list(global = global_wide, dunn = dunn_tbl, skipped = skipped)
}

unpaired_original <- compute_unpaired_all(immune_patient, "ORIGINAL", drop_small_groups_n = 2, write_outputs = FALSE)
unpaired_aggregated <- compute_unpaired_all(immune_patient_aggregated, "AGGREGATED", drop_small_groups_n = 2, write_outputs = TRUE)
```

# Paired statistics

Within each CIMIC cluster, the pipeline performs paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests comparing surgery versus biopsy for each method and cell type.

```{r paired-stats}
make_skip_row_paired <- function(Method, Cell_Type, cluster, reason, n_pairs = NA_integer_, n_unique_delta = NA_integer_) {
  tibble(analysis = "paired", Method = Method, Cell_Type = Cell_Type, cluster = as.character(cluster), reason = reason, n_pairs = n_pairs, n_unique_delta = n_unique_delta)
}

paired_one <- function(df, Method, Cell_Type, cluster_label, expected_pairs_df) {
  expected_cluster <- expected_pairs_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(as.character(cluster) == as.character(cluster_label)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Patient_ID)

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Patient_ID), !is.na(Timepoint), !is.na(cluster))

  # At this stage technical replicates should already have been collapsed.
  dup <- df %>%
    dplyr::count(Patient_ID, Timepoint, name = "n_rows") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_rows > 1)
  if (nrow(dup) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate patient/timepoint rows reached paired statistics for ",
      Method, " / ", Cell_Type, " / ", as.character(cluster_label),
      ": ", paste0(dup$Patient_ID, "(", dup$Timepoint, ")", collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  observed_availability <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Timepoint_chr = as.character(Timepoint),
      valid_value = is.finite(Value)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      has_valid_biopsy = any(Timepoint_chr == "Biopsy" & valid_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      has_valid_surgery = any(Timepoint_chr == "Surgery" & valid_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  pair_audit <- expected_cluster %>%
    dplyr::left_join(observed_availability, by = "Patient_ID") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      has_valid_biopsy = tidyr::replace_na(has_valid_biopsy, FALSE),
      has_valid_surgery = tidyr::replace_na(has_valid_surgery, FALSE),
      included_pair = has_valid_biopsy & has_valid_surgery,
      exclusion_reason = dplyr::case_when(
        included_pair ~ NA_character_,
        !has_valid_biopsy & !has_valid_surgery ~ "missing_or_nonfinite_both_timepoints",
        !has_valid_biopsy ~ "missing_or_nonfinite_biopsy",
        !has_valid_surgery ~ "missing_or_nonfinite_surgery",
        TRUE ~ "incomplete_pair"
      ),
      Method = as.character(Method),
      Cell_Type = as.character(Cell_Type),
      cluster = as.character(cluster_label)
    )

  wide <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(Value)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Timepoint, Value) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = Value) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(Biopsy), is.finite(Surgery))

  unexpected_wide <- wide %>%
    dplyr::anti_join(expected_cluster, by = "Patient_ID")
  if (nrow(unexpected_wide) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Unexpected patient(s) entered paired analysis for ",
      Method, " / ", Cell_Type, " / ", as.character(cluster_label),
      ": ", paste(unexpected_wide$Patient_ID, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  n_candidates <- nrow(pair_audit)
  n_pairs_actual <- sum(pair_audit$included_pair)
  n_dropped <- n_candidates - n_pairs_actual

  if (nrow(wide) != n_pairs_actual) {
    stop(
      "Paired-count consistency check failed for ", Method, " / ", Cell_Type,
      " / ", as.character(cluster_label), ": wide table has ", nrow(wide),
      " complete pairs but audit counted ", n_pairs_actual, ".",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (nrow(wide) == 0) {
    return(list(
      stats = NULL,
      wide = NULL,
      skip = make_skip_row_paired(Method, Cell_Type, cluster_label, "no_complete_pairs", 0),
      pair_audit = pair_audit
    ))
  }

  wide <- wide %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Delta = Surgery - Biopsy,
      nonzero_delta = Delta != 0
    )

  n_pairs <- nrow(wide)
  n_zero_delta <- sum(!wide$nonzero_delta)
  n_nonzero_delta <- sum(wide$nonzero_delta)
  n_unique_delta <- dplyr::n_distinct(wide$Delta)

  stats_base <- tibble(
    Method = as.character(Method),
    Cell_Type = as.character(Cell_Type),
    cluster = as.character(cluster_label),
    n_candidates = n_candidates,
    n_pairs = n_pairs,
    n_dropped = n_dropped,
    n_zero_delta = n_zero_delta,
    n_nonzero_delta = n_nonzero_delta,
    mean_biopsy = mean(wide$Biopsy),
    sd_biopsy = stats::sd(wide$Biopsy),
    mean_surgery = mean(wide$Surgery),
    sd_surgery = stats::sd(wide$Surgery),
    mean_delta = mean(wide$Delta),
    sd_delta = stats::sd(wide$Delta)
  )

  if (n_pairs < MIN_PAIRED_N) {
    return(list(
      stats = stats_base %>% dplyr::mutate(p_value = NA_real_, note = paste0("skipped_n_pairs<", MIN_PAIRED_N)),
      wide = wide %>% dplyr::mutate(Method = as.character(Method), Cell_Type = as.character(Cell_Type), cluster = as.character(cluster_label)),
      skip = make_skip_row_paired(Method, Cell_Type, cluster_label, "n_pairs_too_small", n_pairs, n_unique_delta),
      pair_audit = pair_audit
    ))
  }

  # Wilcoxon signed-rank discards zero differences from the rank calculation.
  # Only an all-zero delta vector makes the signed-rank test undefined.
  if (n_nonzero_delta == 0) {
    return(list(
      stats = stats_base %>% dplyr::mutate(p_value = NA_real_, note = "skipped_all_zero_deltas"),
      wide = wide %>% dplyr::mutate(Method = as.character(Method), Cell_Type = as.character(Cell_Type), cluster = as.character(cluster_label)),
      skip = make_skip_row_paired(Method, Cell_Type, cluster_label, "all_zero_deltas", n_pairs, n_unique_delta),
      pair_audit = pair_audit
    ))
  }

  p <- tryCatch(
    stats::wilcox.test(
      wide$Surgery,
      wide$Biopsy,
      paired = TRUE,
      alternative = "two.sided",
      exact = FALSE,
      correct = TRUE
    )$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  list(
    stats = stats_base %>% dplyr::mutate(p_value = p, note = NA_character_),
    wide = wide %>% dplyr::mutate(Method = as.character(Method), Cell_Type = as.character(Cell_Type), cluster = as.character(cluster_label)),
    skip = NULL,
    pair_audit = pair_audit
  )
}

compute_paired_all <- function(immune_patient_df, out_prefix, write_outputs = FALSE) {
  # Safety step: paired tests are stratified by mapped CIM groups.
  immune_patient_df <- apply_cluster_mapping(immune_patient_df) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = droplevels(cluster))

  groups <- immune_patient_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Method, Cell_Type, cluster) %>%
    dplyr::group_split(.keep = TRUE)

  paired_results <- purrr::map(
    groups,
    ~ paired_one(
      .x,
      .x$Method[[1]],
      .x$Cell_Type[[1]],
      .x$cluster[[1]],
      expected_pairs_df = expected_paired_patients
    )
  )

  stats_tbl <- purrr::map(paired_results, "stats") %>% bind_rows()
  wide_tbl <- purrr::map(paired_results, "wide") %>% bind_rows()
  skip_tbl <- purrr::map(paired_results, "skip") %>% bind_rows()
  pair_audit_tbl <- purrr::map(paired_results, "pair_audit") %>% bind_rows()

  stats_tbl <- stats_tbl %>%
    group_by(Method, cluster) %>%
    mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Method, cluster, Cell_Type)

  if (nrow(skip_tbl) == 0) {
    skip_tbl <- tibble(analysis = character(), Method = character(), Cell_Type = character(), cluster = character(), reason = character(), n_pairs = integer(), n_unique_delta = integer())
  }

  pair_completeness_summary <- pair_audit_tbl %>%
    group_by(Method, Cell_Type, cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      n_candidates = n(),
      n_pairs_used = sum(included_pair),
      n_dropped = sum(!included_pair),
      n_missing_biopsy = sum(exclusion_reason == "missing_or_nonfinite_biopsy", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_surgery = sum(exclusion_reason == "missing_or_nonfinite_surgery", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_both = sum(exclusion_reason == "missing_or_nonfinite_both_timepoints", na.rm = TRUE),
      dropped_patient_ids = paste(Patient_ID[!included_pair], collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Method, cluster, Cell_Type)

  if (isTRUE(write_outputs)) {
    write.csv(stats_tbl, file.path(DIRS$tables, paste0(out_prefix, "_paired_stats.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    # Patient-level exclusions/invalid pairs are retained in CSVs, not on figures.
    write.csv(pair_audit_tbl, file.path(DIRS$tables, paste0(out_prefix, "_paired_pair_completeness_by_patient.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(pair_completeness_summary, file.path(DIRS$tables, paste0(out_prefix, "_paired_pair_completeness_summary.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  }

  list(
    stats = stats_tbl,
    wide = wide_tbl,
    skipped = skip_tbl,
    pair_audit = pair_audit_tbl,
    pair_completeness = pair_completeness_summary
  )
}

paired_original <- compute_paired_all(immune_patient, "ORIGINAL", write_outputs = FALSE)
paired_aggregated <- compute_paired_all(immune_patient_aggregated, "AGGREGATED", write_outputs = TRUE)
```

# Plots

The plotting layer deliberately includes **all** returned cell types and score endpoints. In particular, score-like outputs such as `immune score`, `cytotoxicity score`, `ImmuneScore`, `StromalScore`, and `ESTIMATEScore` are not filtered out. Plot generation is audited so that any failed or skipped plot is written to a CSV instead of silently disappearing.

```{r plotting-functions}
# Unpaired figures are strictly patient-level. Upstream QC requires exactly one
# value per Patient_ID for each Method × Cell_Type × Timepoint combination; the
# plotting layer does not silently average or discard duplicates. A box may still
# collapse to a horizontal line when Q1 = median = Q3 (IQR = 0), which is a genuine
# feature of the data and is not artificially expanded.

# Choose which value to display on unpaired plots.
PLOT_P_COLUMN <- "p_value"
# PLOT_P_COLUMN <- "FDR"   # Use this instead for adjusted P values.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature-specific y-axis limits
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Earlier versions used a method-wide lower bound. That is unnecessarily broad
# for methods that return heterogeneous outputs (cell scores + composite scores)
# and can visually compress individual endpoints. We now compute limits from the
# actual Method x Cell_Type data being plotted.
feature_ylims <- function(values, lower_zero_if_nonnegative = TRUE) {
  v <- as.numeric(values)
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]

  if (!length(v)) return(c(0, 0.01))

  vmin <- min(v)
  vmax <- max(v)
  span <- vmax - vmin

  if (!is.finite(span) || span <= 0) {
    span <- max(abs(vmax) * 0.20, 0.01)
  }

  lower <- if (lower_zero_if_nonnegative && vmin >= 0) 0 else vmin - 0.08 * span
  upper <- vmax + 0.18 * span

  if (!is.finite(lower) || !is.finite(upper) || lower >= upper) {
    lower <- vmin - 0.01
    upper <- vmax + 0.01
  }

  c(lower, upper)
}

compute_shared_ylims <- function(df, method_ymin = NULL) {
  feature_ylims(df$Value)
}

format_plot_p <- function(p) {
  if (length(p) == 0 || is.na(p) || !is.finite(p)) return("P = N/A")
  if (p < 0.0001) return("P < 0.0001")
  paste0("P = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4))
}

plot_unpaired_one <- function(
    df,
    shared_ylim,
    unpaired_stats,
    p_column = PLOT_P_COLUMN
) {
  # Plot exactly the patient-level observations used by the unpaired test.
  # Duplicates are not averaged here; they indicate an upstream integrity issue.
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(Value), !is.na(cluster), !is.na(Patient_ID))

  dup <- df %>%
    dplyr::count(Patient_ID, name = "n_rows") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_rows > 1)
  if (nrow(dup) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate patients reached unpaired plotting: ",
      paste(dup$Patient_ID, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (dplyr::n_distinct(df$cluster) < 2) return(NULL)

  method_name <- as.character(unique(df$Method)[1])
  cell_type   <- as.character(unique(df$Cell_Type)[1])
  timepoint   <- as.character(unique(df$Timepoint)[1])

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = names(cluster_colors)))

  stat_row <- unpaired_stats %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint)) %>%
    filter(
      Method == method_name,
      Cell_Type == cell_type,
      Timepoint == timepoint
    )

  if (nrow(stat_row) > 1) {
    stop("Multiple unpaired-stat rows matched one plot: ", method_name, " / ", cell_type, " / ", timepoint, call. = FALSE)
  }

  # The figure and the statistical table must use exactly the same patient n.
  if (nrow(stat_row) == 1) {
    for (cl in levels(df$cluster)) {
      n_col <- paste0(cl, "_n")
      if (n_col %in% names(stat_row)) {
        n_plot <- dplyr::n_distinct(df$Patient_ID[as.character(df$cluster) == cl])
        n_stat <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(stat_row[[n_col]][1]))
        if (!is.na(n_stat) && n_plot != n_stat) {
          stop(
            "Unpaired plot/stat n mismatch for ", method_name, " / ", cell_type,
            " / ", timepoint, " / ", cl, ": plot n=", n_plot,
            ", stats n=", n_stat, ".",
            call. = FALSE
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (!p_column %in% names(stat_row) || nrow(stat_row) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No unpaired statistic matched plot: ", method_name, " / ", cell_type,
      " / ", timepoint, ". Expected column: ", p_column, ".",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    p_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stat_row[[p_column]][1]))
    if (!is.finite(p_value)) {
      stat_note <- if ("note" %in% names(stat_row)) as.character(stat_row$note[1]) else NA_character_
      stop(
        "Unpaired P value is NA/non-finite for ", method_name, " / ", cell_type,
        " / ", timepoint,
        if (!is.na(stat_note) && nzchar(stat_note)) paste0(" (", stat_note, ")") else "",
        ". Check AGGREGATED_unpaired_global.csv and the warnings above.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  p_label <- format_plot_p(p_value)
  y_position <- shared_ylim[2] - 0.05 * diff(shared_ylim)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = cluster, y = Value, fill = cluster)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = NA,
      width = PLOT_BOX_WIDTH,
      alpha = PLOT_BOX_ALPHA,
      linewidth = PLOT_BOX_LINEWIDTH,
      color = "gray20"
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = PLOT_JITTER_WIDTH,
      alpha = PLOT_UNPAIRED_POINT_ALPHA,
      size = PLOT_UNPAIRED_POINT_SIZE,
      color = "gray20"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_position,
      label = p_label,
      size = PLOT_P_ANNOTATION_SIZE,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, name = "Cluster", drop = FALSE) +
    theme_pub() +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = shared_ylim, clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(cell_type, " — ", timepoint),
      x = "",
      y = method_value_type(method_name)
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

save_unpaired_plots <- function(
    immune_patient_df,
    method_ymin,
    version_label,
    unpaired_stats,
    p_column = PLOT_P_COLUMN
) {
  immune_patient_df <- apply_cluster_mapping(immune_patient_df) %>%
    mutate(cluster = droplevels(cluster))

  out_dir <- DIRS$plots
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  combinations <- immune_patient_df %>%
    distinct(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint) %>%
    arrange(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint)

  audit_rows <- vector("list", nrow(combinations))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(combinations))) {
    method_i <- combinations$Method[[i]]
    cell_type_i <- combinations$Cell_Type[[i]]
    timepoint_i <- combinations$Timepoint[[i]]

    # IMPORTANT: use uniquely named environment variables on the RHS.
    # Using `Method`, `Cell_Type`, or `Timepoint` as loop variables here can
    # collide with identically named data columns inside dplyr::filter(),
    # causing a condition such as `.data$Method == Method` to evaluate as
    # column == itself and unintentionally retain every method/cell type.
    plot_data <- immune_patient_df %>%
      filter(
        .data$Method == .env$method_i,
        .data$Cell_Type == .env$cell_type_i,
        .data$Timepoint == .env$timepoint_i,
        is.finite(.data$Value),
        !is.na(.data$cluster),
        !is.na(.data$Patient_ID)
      )

    # Hard QC: an unpaired method/cell-type/timepoint plot must contain at most
    # one observation per patient. Stop rather than silently drawing a malformed
    # figure if duplicate patient rows survive upstream processing.
    dup_qc <- plot_data %>%
      count(Patient_ID, name = "n_rows") %>%
      filter(n_rows > 1)
    if (nrow(dup_qc) > 0) {
      stop(
        "Duplicate patient observations remain in unpaired plot data for ",
        method_i, " / ", cell_type_i, " / ", as.character(timepoint_i),
        ". Patient IDs: ", paste(dup_qc$Patient_ID, collapse = ", "),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    plot_subdir <- if (identical(version_label, "ORIGINAL")) "unpaired_original" else "unpaired"
    method_dir <- file.path(out_dir, method_dir_name(method_i), plot_subdir)
    dir.create(method_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    file_png <- file.path(
      method_dir,
      paste0(safe_stem(timepoint_i, cell_type_i), ".png")
    )

    status <- "saved"
    error_message <- NA_character_

    if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
      status <- "skipped_no_data"
    } else if (n_distinct(plot_data$cluster) < 2) {
      status <- "skipped_lt2_groups"
    } else {
      tryCatch({
        shared_ylim <- compute_shared_ylims(plot_data, method_ymin)
        plot_object <- plot_unpaired_one(
          df = plot_data,
          shared_ylim = shared_ylim,
          unpaired_stats = unpaired_stats,
          p_column = p_column
        )

        if (is.null(plot_object)) {
          status <- "skipped_plot_null"
        } else {
          ggsave(
            file_png,
            plot_object,
            width = PLOT_WIDTH_UNPAIRED,
            height = PLOT_HEIGHT_UNPAIRED,
            dpi = PLOT_DPI
          )
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        status <<- "failed"
        error_message <<- conditionMessage(e)
      })
    }

    audit_rows[[i]] <- tibble(
      version = version_label,
      plot_type = "unpaired",
      Method = method_i,
      Cell_Type = cell_type_i,
      Timepoint = as.character(timepoint_i),
      cluster = NA_character_,
      n_values = nrow(plot_data),
      n_patients = n_distinct(plot_data$Patient_ID),
      n_C1 = n_distinct(plot_data$Patient_ID[as.character(plot_data$cluster) == "C1"]),
      n_C2 = n_distinct(plot_data$Patient_ID[as.character(plot_data$cluster) == "C2"]),
      n_C3 = n_distinct(plot_data$Patient_ID[as.character(plot_data$cluster) == "C3"]),
      n_groups = n_distinct(plot_data$cluster),
      output_file = file_png,
      file_exists = file.exists(file_png),
      status = status,
      error_message = error_message
    )
  }

  audit <- bind_rows(audit_rows)
  audit
}

compute_shared_ylims_paired <- function(paired_wide_df, method, cell_type, method_ymin = NULL) {
  all_values <- paired_wide_df %>%
    filter(.data$Method == method, .data$Cell_Type == cell_type) %>%
    select(Biopsy, Surgery) %>%
    unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
    as.numeric()

  feature_ylims(all_values)
}

plot_paired_split_one <- function(
    paired_wide_df,
    paired_stats_df,
    method,
    cell_type,
    cluster_level,
    shared_ylim
) {
  d <- paired_wide_df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Method == method,
      .data$Cell_Type == cell_type,
      as.character(.data$cluster) == as.character(cluster_level)
    )

  if (nrow(d) < 3) return(NULL)

  stat_row <- paired_stats_df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Method == method,
      .data$Cell_Type == cell_type,
      as.character(.data$cluster) == as.character(cluster_level)
    )

  pval <- if (nrow(stat_row) > 0) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stat_row$p_value[[1]])) else NA_real_
  p_label <- format_plot_p(pval)

  # Display only the actual number of complete patient pairs used for this
  # metric/cluster. Exclusion details are retained in the paired-completeness
  # CSV outputs rather than shown on the figure.
  n_pairs_used <- nrow(d)

  if (nrow(stat_row) > 0 && "n_pairs" %in% names(stat_row)) {
    n_pairs_stats <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(stat_row$n_pairs[[1]]))
    if (!is.na(n_pairs_stats) && n_pairs_stats != n_pairs_used) {
      stop(
        "Paired plot-count consistency check failed for ", method, " / ", cell_type,
        " / ", as.character(cluster_level), ": plot has ", n_pairs_used,
        " pairs but paired statistics report ", n_pairs_stats, ".",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  pair_subtitle <- paste0("n = ", n_pairs_used, " pairs")

  plot_df <- d %>%
    select(Patient_ID, Biopsy, Surgery) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Biopsy, Surgery),
      names_to = "Timepoint",
      values_to = "Value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Biopsy", "Surgery")))

  y_position <- shared_ylim[2] - 0.05 * diff(shared_ylim)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Value, group = Patient_ID)) +
    geom_line(
      color = PLOT_PAIRED_LINE_COLOR,
      alpha = PLOT_PAIRED_LINE_ALPHA,
      linewidth = PLOT_PAIRED_LINE_WIDTH
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = Timepoint),
      size = PLOT_PAIRED_POINT_SIZE,
      alpha = PLOT_PAIRED_POINT_ALPHA
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = TIMEPOINT_COLORS, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_pub() +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = shared_ylim, clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(cell_type, " — ", as.character(cluster_level)),
      subtitle = pair_subtitle,
      x = "",
      y = method_value_type(method)
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_position,
      label = p_label,
      size = PLOT_P_ANNOTATION_SIZE,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

save_paired_split_plots <- function(paired_obj, method_ymin, version_label) {
  paired_obj$wide <- apply_cluster_mapping(paired_obj$wide) %>%
    mutate(cluster = droplevels(cluster))

  paired_obj$stats <- apply_cluster_mapping(paired_obj$stats) %>%
    mutate(cluster = droplevels(cluster))

  out_dir <- DIRS$plots
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  wide <- paired_obj$wide
  stats <- paired_obj$stats

  combos <- wide %>%
    distinct(Method, Cell_Type, cluster) %>%
    arrange(Method, Cell_Type, cluster)

  audit_rows <- vector("list", nrow(combos))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
    method_i <- combos$Method[[i]]
    cell_type_i <- combos$Cell_Type[[i]]
    cluster_i <- as.character(combos$cluster[[i]])

    # Use explicit environment variables to prevent dplyr data-mask name
    # collisions (column == column), which would otherwise mix methods,
    # cell types, and CIM trajectories in a single paired figure.
    d <- wide %>%
      filter(
        .data$Method == .env$method_i,
        .data$Cell_Type == .env$cell_type_i,
        as.character(.data$cluster) == .env$cluster_i
      )

    plot_subdir <- if (identical(version_label, "ORIGINAL")) "paired_original" else "paired"
    method_dir <- file.path(out_dir, method_dir_name(method_i), plot_subdir)
    dir.create(method_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    file_png <- file.path(
      method_dir,
      paste0(safe_stem(cluster_file_label(cluster_i), cell_type_i), ".png")
    )

    status <- "saved"
    error_message <- NA_character_

    if (nrow(d) < 3) {
      status <- "skipped_lt3_pairs"
    } else {
      tryCatch({
        shared_ylim <- compute_shared_ylims_paired(wide, method_i, cell_type_i, method_ymin)
        p <- plot_paired_split_one(
          paired_wide_df = wide,
          paired_stats_df = stats,
          method = method_i,
          cell_type = cell_type_i,
          cluster_level = cluster_i,
          shared_ylim = shared_ylim
        )

        if (is.null(p)) {
          status <- "skipped_plot_null"
        } else {
          ggsave(
            file_png,
            p,
            width = PLOT_WIDTH_PAIRED,
            height = PLOT_HEIGHT_PAIRED,
            dpi = PLOT_DPI
          )
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        status <<- "failed"
        error_message <<- conditionMessage(e)
      })
    }

    audit_rows[[i]] <- tibble(
      version = version_label,
      plot_type = "paired",
      Method = method_i,
      Cell_Type = cell_type_i,
      Timepoint = NA_character_,
      cluster = cluster_i,
      n_values = 2L * nrow(d),
      n_pairs_used = nrow(d),
      n_groups = 1L,
      output_file = file_png,
      file_exists = file.exists(file_png),
      status = status,
      error_message = error_message
    )
  }

  audit <- bind_rows(audit_rows)
  audit
}
```

```{r run-plots}
if (params$make_plots) {
  # Optional original-method plots (off by default).
  if (isTRUE(MAKE_ORIGINAL_PLOTS)) {
    save_unpaired_plots(
      immune_patient,
      method_ymin_original,
      "ORIGINAL",
      unpaired_original$global
    )
    save_paired_split_plots(
      paired_original,
      method_ymin_original,
      "ORIGINAL"
    )
  }

  unpaired_plot_audit <- save_unpaired_plots(
    immune_patient_aggregated,
    method_ymin_aggregated,
    "AGGREGATED",
    unpaired_aggregated$global
  )

  paired_plot_audit <- save_paired_split_plots(
    paired_aggregated,
    method_ymin_aggregated,
    "AGGREGATED"
  )

  # Hard check for key cytotoxicity endpoints. If the data exist but the plot was
  # not saved, stop with a targeted message rather than silently finishing.
  cytotox_unpaired_expected <- immune_patient_aggregated %>%
    filter(Cell_Type == "cytotoxicity score") %>%
    distinct(Method, Cell_Type, Timepoint)

  cytotox_paired_expected <- paired_aggregated$wide %>%
    filter(Cell_Type == "cytotoxicity score") %>%
    distinct(Method, Cell_Type, cluster)

  cytotox_unpaired_failed <- unpaired_plot_audit %>%
    filter(Cell_Type == "cytotoxicity score", status != "saved")

  cytotox_paired_failed <- paired_plot_audit %>%
    filter(Cell_Type == "cytotoxicity score", status != "saved")

  if (nrow(cytotox_unpaired_expected) > 0 && nrow(cytotox_unpaired_failed) > 0) {
    warning(
      "One or more cytotoxicity-score unpaired plots were not saved.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (nrow(cytotox_paired_expected) > 0 && nrow(cytotox_paired_failed) > 0) {
    warning(
      "One or more cytotoxicity-score paired plots were not saved.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

# Heatmaps

The cluster-level heatmap uses mean delta values, where delta is defined as:

```text
Delta = Surgery - Biopsy
```

Mean deltas are z-scored within each deconvolution method.

```{r heatmap-functions}
calculate_zscore_cluster_mean_deltas <- function(paired_wide_df) {
  paired_wide_df <- apply_cluster_mapping(paired_wide_df) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = droplevels(cluster))

  required_cols <- c("Method", "Cell_Type", "cluster", "Biopsy", "Surgery", "Delta")
  missing_cols <- base::setdiff(required_cols, colnames(paired_wide_df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))

  paired_wide_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
    group_by(Method, Cell_Type, cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      n_pairs = n(),
      mean_biopsy = mean(Biopsy, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_biopsy = sd(Biopsy, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_surgery = mean(Surgery, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_surgery = sd(Surgery, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_delta = mean(Delta, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_delta = sd(Delta, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_value = if (n() >= 3) tryCatch(wilcox.test(Surgery, Biopsy, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_pairs >= 3) %>%
    group_by(Method, cluster) %>%
    mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Method) %>%
    mutate(zscore_delta = safe_zscore(mean_delta)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

prepare_method_cell_by_cluster_matrix <- function(zscore_deltas, fill_na = FALSE) {
  zscore_deltas <- zscore_deltas %>%
    mutate(CellType_Method = paste0(Method, ": ", Cell_Type), cluster = as.character(cluster)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(cluster))

  cluster_order <- unique(unname(CLUSTER_MAPPING))
  present_clusters <- unique(as.character(zscore_deltas$cluster))
  clusts_display <- cluster_order[cluster_order %in% present_clusters]
  if (length(clusts_display) == 0) clusts_display <- present_clusters

  mat <- zscore_deltas %>%
    select(CellType_Method, cluster, zscore_delta) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = zscore_delta) %>%
    column_to_rownames("CellType_Method") %>%
    as.matrix()

  sig_mat <- zscore_deltas %>%
    select(CellType_Method, cluster, FDR) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = FDR) %>%
    column_to_rownames("CellType_Method") %>%
    as.matrix()

  mat <- mat[, clusts_display, drop = FALSE]
  sig_mat <- sig_mat[, clusts_display, drop = FALSE]
  if (fill_na) mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

  method_anno <- data.frame(
    CellType_Method = rownames(mat),
    Method = sub(":.*$", "", rownames(mat)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  method_anno$Method <- factor(method_anno$Method, levels = METHOD_ORDER)
  ord <- order(method_anno$Method, method_anno$CellType_Method)

  list(mat = mat[ord, , drop = FALSE], sig = sig_mat[ord, , drop = FALSE], anno = method_anno[ord, , drop = FALSE])
}

plot_cluster_delta_heatmap <- function(zscore_deltas, output_file, show_significance = TRUE, cluster_rows = TRUE, fill_na = FALSE, na_col = "grey90") {
  prep <- prepare_method_cell_by_cluster_matrix(zscore_deltas, fill_na = fill_na)
  mat <- prep$mat
  sig <- prep$sig
  anno <- prep$anno

  if (nrow(mat) == 0 || ncol(mat) == 0 || all(is.na(mat))) stop("Heatmap matrix is empty or all NA.")

  max_abs <- max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_abs) || max_abs == 0) max_abs <- 2
  max_abs <- max(max_abs, 2)

  col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-max_abs, -1, 0, 1, max_abs), c("#0571B0", "#92C5DE", "white", "#F4A582", "#CA0020"))

  methods_present <- unique(as.character(anno$Method))
  method_colors_subset <- METHOD_COLORS[methods_present]
  method_colors_subset <- method_colors_subset[!is.na(method_colors_subset)]

  row_ha <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
    Method = anno$Method,
    col = list(Method = method_colors_subset),
    annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold")
  )

  cell_fun <- NULL
  if (show_significance) {
    cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      fdr <- sig[i, j]
      if (is.na(fdr)) return(NULL)
      label <- if (fdr < 0.001) "***" else if (fdr < 0.01) "**" else if (fdr < 0.05) "*" else ""
      if (label != "") grid::grid.text(label, x, y, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"))
    }
  }

  display_names <- stringr::str_remove(rownames(mat), "^[^:]+: ")

  ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    mat,
    name = "Z-score\n(mean Δ)",
    col = col_fun,
    na_col = na_col,
    cell_fun = cell_fun,
    row_names_side = "left",
    row_labels = display_names,
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
    cluster_rows = cluster_rows,
    show_row_dend = cluster_rows,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
    column_names_rot = 0,
    column_title = "Cluster-mean zΔ (Surgery - Biopsy)",
    column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
    left_annotation = row_ha,
    border = TRUE
  )

  plot_height <- max(10, nrow(mat) * 0.15 + 3)
  png(output_file, width = 12, height = plot_height, units = "in", res = 300)
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "bottom")
  dev.off()

  output_file
}
```

```{r run-heatmaps}
if (params$make_heatmaps) {
  zscore_deltas_agg <- calculate_zscore_cluster_mean_deltas(paired_aggregated$wide)

  write.csv(zscore_deltas_agg, file.path(DIRS$tables, "AGGREGATED_zscore_cluster_mean_deltas.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  prep_tmp <- prepare_method_cell_by_cluster_matrix(zscore_deltas_agg, fill_na = FALSE)
  write.csv(prep_tmp$mat, file.path(DIRS$tables, "AGGREGATED_heatmap_matrix_zscore_delta.csv"))

  heat_file <- file.path(DIRS$plots, "heatmap_zDelta.png")
  plot_cluster_delta_heatmap(zscore_deltas_agg, heat_file, show_significance = TRUE, cluster_rows = TRUE, fill_na = FALSE)
}
```
